This name imparts the traits of a strong and capable leader who is firm in their beliefs and responsibilities.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Kadar is closely linked to the idea of trust, faith, and reliance on Allah. The name Kadar implies a deep sense of trust in Allah to provide, help, and guide us through life's trials and tribulations. The name Kadar also reflects our human potential to be providers, helpers, and leaders in our communities, emulating the qualities and attributes of Allah.
